_doc: GoodQA #15565 ask hygiene. mode: off | warn | enforce. human_only terms always keep an ask (the harness rules reserve these steps for a person). agent_doable rules refuse an ask an agent can do itself. A GRANT: row of the user's own words in the main log refuses asks that share min_shared distinctive words with it.

agent_doable.why: stopping a process you own is `ah kill --pid N --reason R`; a foreign process needs the user's OK only for --foreign
an account the user already owns is reached through his GoodQA user token, an email approve link or device code, or secure-login (CLAUDE.md section 4)
an agent can run, click, open or check this itself
